**Round-5 user audit feedback (2026-04-28):**

1. **Diff format directive (final).** User wants ONE comprehensive BEFORE+AFTER table covering ALL doc/home changes from the original audit through round-5 (all 90+ items). The previous tables had abstract "reframed as" language; this table must be literal text on every line. After homepage round-5 lands, deliver this table. Cross-tool.` Hyphens within compound words stay (those are grammatical).
